summary: Multimodal rerankers are usually dedicated models: a vision-language model (VLM) is trained on retrieval data to score the candidates of a query. Scoring options is not specific to reranking.
takeaways: System One decision models such as Jev map a state and a typed question to one probability per option without generating text, and general models can make such decisions with little or no training.
On MMEB-V2 image retrieval, this choice scores 5.4 to 7.3 hit@1 above a yes/no question per candidate, and the yes/no question falls below the first stage.
Reranking is one such decision, with the query and its candidates as the state and the candidates as the options.
